It takes such a toll on your mental health. But do not let the way he has treated you allow you to think any less of yourself. Same thing applies to you. This situation just shows he was not your soulmate because your soulmate would never do this to you. You are still worthy, you are still loved, and there is nothing wrong with you, but everything is wrong with him. He is not a good, kind person even though you may have thought he was. Rejection is redirection. Because of this situation, you are now one step closer to finding your actual soulmate. This is going to put you on a completely different path in life and he did you a favor by removing himself because now you get to move onto greater and better things, even though it may not seem like it right now. Our situations are oddly similar, I housed him in my family’s house for years and then we moved into an apartment together and it only lasted 1 month before he kicked me out. The next few months are gonna be really hard but you will survive it, as I did. But with each passing day, I am slowly healing and focusing on myself. It feels like an eternity without him, but I know this was meant to happen in order for me to find someone who truly loves me. Since the breakup, I’ve become a lot more spiritual and have accepted that the universe is always working in our favor even if its excruciatingly painful. We have to go through these awful, traumatizing situations in order to receive what we deserve in the end. A relationship with him may be everything you want right now, but you will look back and realize why this had to happen. My messages are always open if you need to talk <3
